svg.title: Four live rounds, one pooled slate
svg.desc: Phase 2 · on-site final · Dublin, 14–15 Nov 2026. Four live rounds, one pooled slate. Recommend one item per request; every team's pick lands in the same slate. 53.71 round 3 score, highest of all 15 teams. 400,000 requests per round, rounds 3 and 4. 240 s per scoring run, imports included.
